comment: Pinned source registry for the automated cadence. Every entry maps a primary source to the matrix rows whose status depends on it. Adding a source here is the only way to bring it under automated watch; see docs/agent-cadence.md.

sources.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
sources.note: Backing docs repository MicrosoftDocs/Purview-pr is not public (raw fetch returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-07), so HTML fingerprinting is required for this source. Re-probe periodically: if a public mirror appears, switch mode to 'markdown'.

sources.title: AI threat protection in Microsoft Defender for Cloud
sources.note: Backing docs repository MicrosoftDocs/defender-docs is public (raw fetch returned HTTP 200 on 2026-08-07). Watching the source markdown avoids rendered-page navigation churn entirely. cite_url is the Microsoft Learn URL that must appear in the matrix; the raw URL is a fetch mechanism only and is never cited as a primary source.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud release notes
sources.note: Carries the dated GA / Preview entries that evidence row 4's status dates. This page also carries dozens of release notes for products outside this repository's scope (containers, SQL, Kubernetes); without relevance_filter the fingerprint would change on almost every run and the detector would escalate constantly for entries that cannot affect any matrix row.

sources.title: Microsoft Defender for Cloud release notes archive
sources.note: Holds the dated 'General Availability for Defender for AI Services - May 1, 2025' entry that row 4's GA date rests on. Added on 2026-08-07 after the citation-containment validator found this URL cited in the matrix but absent from the registry.

sources.title: Microsoft 365 Roadmap feature 548671
sources.note: The per-feature endpoint (/api/v1/m365/features/<id>) returned HTTP 404 on 2026-08-07; the collection endpoint returned HTTP 200 and contains the feature. The watcher fetches the collection and selects by feature_id.

human_only_sources.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center
human_only_sources.reason: Message Center posts are tenant-scoped and have no public URL (docs/how-to-read-status.md). Reading them would require a tenant credential in repository secrets and would introduce tenant-scoped data, which disclaimer.md and the README confidentiality note forbid. This source is therefore permanently human-only and is never fetched by any workflow.

human_only_sources.title: CSA AI Controls Matrix (AICM) spreadsheet
human_only_sources.reason: Published only inside a registration-gated spreadsheet on the CSA artifact page (crosswalk/framework-crosswalk.md). Not machine-fetchable; control-ID mappings must be re-verified by a human against the AICM workbook.
